records.title: Select the v2 contract

instructions: Replace the conformant source value 1.1 with 2.0 after verifying the source baseline.

records.rationale: The required version marker is the explicit major-version boundary.

records.title: Apply the portable YAML input profile

instructions: Decode every source as one UTF-8 YAML 1.2 Core mapping with string unique keys, permitted aliases, and exact finite values; re-author unsupported YAML forms without changing their decoded intent.

records.rationale: Previously host-dependent YAML forms cannot receive an automatic portable rewrite without the original presentation and intended decoded value.

records.title: Re-evaluate modules and composition

instructions: Resolve paths from each containing file, compare the v2 depth-first postorder result with the intended architecture, and restructure modules when values or identity-keyed entries differ.
decisions: Confirm the canonical source graph and intended winning value for each changed composition result.

records.rationale: Containing-file precedence, diamonds, limits, local source validity, and whole-entry replacement are now exact and can change the assembled value.

records.title: Validate complete fragment declarations

instructions: Repair invalid authored values and incomplete array items in their originating source; do not rely on a later override to hide them.

records.rationale: The target baseline validates local authored facts before assembly.

records.title: Repair identifiers and references transactionally

instructions: Choose valid exact identifiers for invalid or colliding declarations and update every resolved reference in one transaction.
decisions: Choose the intended identity and target for every invalid, duplicate, unknown, or ambiguous reference.

records.rationale: Trimming, case folding, punctuation replacement, and name similarity can select the wrong architecture element.

records.title: Convert operational scalars with established units

instructions: Append % only to a v1.1 global availability decimal string whose percent meaning and v2 bounds are established; add duration units and convert retry counts only when their original unit/count meaning is known.
preconditions: Each converted scalar has one established source unit and meaning; otherwise emit an author decision.

records.rationale: A bare number or retry count does not reveal a safe unit or whether it counted retries versus total executions.

records.title: Complete domain keys and field constraints

instructions: Select exactly one primary key, convert supported field types and constraints, and resolve foreign-key and relationship targets using exact identities.
decisions: Choose keys, unsupported custom-type treatment, and intended targets; do not infer a key from the name id.

records.rationale: The v2 portable field model closes previously open metadata and requires explicit key intent.

records.title: Type domain indexes, constraints, and relationship roles

instructions: Translate recognized index, uniqueness, foreign-key, and relationship-role intent into the closed records; retain other metadata beneath an x-* field or remove it deliberately.
decisions: Choose ordered fields, target tuples, role identities, explicit selectors, and cardinality consistent with declared uniqueness.

records.rationale: Arbitrary metadata does not identify tuple order, target uniqueness, relationship role, or foreign-key side.

records.title: Separate teams from component bindings

instructions: Declare accountable teams, bind owner only to teams, and place implementation identities in component or managedBy.
decisions: For every old owner string, choose whether it meant an organizational team, implementation component, both through separate fields, or neither.

records.rationale: The source owner field was used with incompatible organizational and component meanings.

records.title: Add project source and primary language

instructions: Leave the new optional fields absent unless repository source and primary language are explicit author facts; placed projects are handled by the deployment record.

records.rationale: Optional declarations do not change old document meaning by themselves.

records.title: Remove dotnet-8 vocabulary

instructions: Map dotnet-8 to dotnet and set runtimeVersion to 8 only when runtimeVersion is absent or already denotes 8; otherwise request a decision.
preconditions: The framework value is exactly dotnet-8 and an authored runtimeVersion does not conflict.

records.rationale: The removed alias combines framework family and SDK version; a conflicting explicit version cannot be overwritten.

records.title: Declare service implementation and integration use

instructions: Identify project implementations or external services and explicitly list integration use where known.
decisions: Choose implementing projects versus external supply and the actual integration consumers; no matching-name inference is allowed.

records.rationale: These relationships did not exist as portable source-baseline facts and are required when deployment/access claims depend on them.

records.title: Identify databases and declare access

instructions: Assign stable logical store IDs and declare known read/write access, entity store bindings, and managers; evaluate ORM compatibility only through those explicit bindings.
decisions: Choose store identities and access modes; a physical database name or primary position is not an identity/access fallback.

records.rationale: Required identities and access relationships cannot be recovered reliably from physical names or array position.

records.title: Relocate deployment into targets and placements

instructions: Create named cloud/region targets, choose active projects/services per environment, place every managed project with source path/runtime, and declare listener network scope.
decisions: Choose target identities and regions, environment selections, service implementations, placement runtimes, and private/shared listener scopes.

records.rationale: Global cloud/runtime and CI environment metadata cannot identify per-project placement or shared infrastructure boundaries.

records.title: Add portable external contract references

instructions: Promote an extension pointer only after resolving its original base, local target, external format/version, and optional structured selector.
decisions: Confirm path base, canonical local file, API type, format/version marker, and selector; otherwise retain the extension unchanged.

records.rationale: An arbitrary extension does not establish root-relative path semantics or an external format contract.

records.title: Complete error and retry policy meaning

instructions: Select managed APIs, complete envelope parent/type/code declarations and policy members, restrict statuses to 400-599, and confirm total-attempt and timing intent.
decisions: Resolve incomplete envelopes, non-error statuses, missing retry members, replay eligibility, attempt-count meaning, and Retry-After handling.

records.rationale: The target shares one retry budget/delay evaluation and does not infer envelope nesting, API applicability, or replay safety.

records.title: Represent database intent and storage identities

instructions: Choose declared, none, or unspecified database intent and assign stable IDs to authored storage resources.
decisions: Confirm whether removal of a placeholder primary database means no database or unknown intent, and choose storage identities.

records.rationale: Although v2 permits database-free documents, deleting a source placeholder cannot safely establish the author's persistence intent.

records.title: Declare environment data topology and recovery

instructions: Declare primary/replica instances for modeled environments and translate recognized recovery intent into one plan or explicit exception for each primary resource.
decisions: Choose targets, topology, plan method, objectives, retention, destinations, intervals, and explicit reasons for no protection.

records.rationale: Open procedural metadata cannot prove resource identity, topology, coverage, or numerical recovery objectives.

records.title: Type costs and compliance mappings

instructions: Create exact currency/period cost scenarios and explicit comparisons; canonicalize only listed compliance aliases/shorthands and retain evidence as open records.
decisions: Choose cost units, subjects, totals/budgets/comparisons, compliance applicability and mappings, and extension placement for unmatched metadata.

records.rationale: Open cost/evidence metadata and shorthand names do not establish comparable amounts, references, applicability, or implementation mappings.

records.title: Reconcile debt and remove implicit defaults

instructions: Resolve divergent same-ID debt, preserve canonical-first order, and decide whether previously inferred architecture values should become authored fields or remain absent; keep provenance and suggestions in sidecars.
decisions: Resolve each debt conflict and every relied-upon v1.1 inferred value before target validation.

records.rationale: The v2 core has a closed normalization set and cannot silently preserve implementation-specific architecture defaults.

records.title: Apply the consolidated field structure and meanings

instructions: Validate every standard field against the self-contained v2 catalogue and semantic slices; preserve explicit falsy/empty values and treat optional omissions as unspecified except for published effective meanings.

records.rationale: Most retained descriptions are clarified compatibly, while new bounds, required identities, security/ORM predicates, and full-pipeline claims are handled by their breaking records.

records.title: Publish scoped validation and normalization results

instructions: Leave SDL content unchanged; emit separate baseline-identified reports and normalization/migration artifacts when those operations are requested.

records.rationale: Sidecar result formats add observable conformance metadata without adding fields to an SDL document.
